literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) reports an 'HHLA2-YFP fusion protein' expressed in Raji cells. By standard fusion-protein naming convention (gene symbol followed by tag), YFP is appended at the C-terminus. HHLA2 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein; its C-terminus (residues 366–414) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. The paper's purpose is to demonstrate that HHLA2 traffics to the cell surface and co-localises with KIR3DL3 at the immunological synapse — the surface display is of HHLA2's ectodomain (residues 23–345), not of YFP. No extracellular junction, loop, or residue is named or implied for the tag. A topology-derived N-terminal extracellular site cannot be inferred from L1 because the tag is demonstrably on the intracellular C-terminus, not the extracellular N-terminus. No other ledger lines exist. Zero extracellular tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal YFP fusion (HHLA2-YFP) is tolerated and the full construct reaches the cell surface, but the C-terminus (residues 366–414) is intracellular; YFP is not surface-accessible.
